catalog.notes: Historical listings reviewed on October 11, 2026. Organizers confirm eligibility. Builder declarations do not establish eligibility. Original research is preserved.

opportunities.title: Solana Foundation · Standard grant
opportunities.reward: Milestone funding; amount subject to review, with no guaranteed award.
opportunities.description: Ongoing review of public goods: open-source contributions, useful free offerings or proofs of concept. Primarily commercial projects should consider convertible grants.

criteria.label: Explain the public benefit for Solana
Explain why Solana benefits the project
Explain licensing and community access to reusable components
Structured budget and use of funds

opportunities.title: Solana Foundation · Convertible grant
opportunities.reward: Milestone-based convertible grant; terms and amount subject to review.
opportunities.description: Public good with a commercial component. This is not a prize or guaranteed funding; confirm conversion terms with the Foundation.

criteria.label: Explain the public benefit and commercial component
Structured budget and use of funds

opportunities.title: Encode Solana Hackathon 2026
opportunities.reward: Accelerator places; no cash prize published.
opportunities.description: Build window: October 12 to November 8. Consumer App and Best Use of x402 on Solana; solo or up to five people. Devnet accepted; disclose prior code. Registration until November 1. Functional demo, repository, 2–4 minute video and explanation of Solana.

criteria.label: Confirm a solo team or up to five members
Functional use of Solana; x402 delivers the resource after verification/settlement
Demo and development plan during the hackathon window

opportunities.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair · Solana
opportunities.reward: Competitive prizes; accelerator investment is separate and subject to selection.
opportunities.description: This edition is close to its deadline. Requires a working integration and compliance with official rules. Do not budget prizes or investment as revenue.
